# Fixture fonts

The Devanagari lines in this folder were rendered with **Noto Sans Devanagari Regular** 2.002 (Copyright 2022 The
Noto Project Authors, https://github.com/notofonts/devanagari), licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org). The font file itself is not in this repository; only images rendered with it are.
Latin lines use the macOS system font Helvetica Neue. `render.swift` regenerates the PNGs and `lines.json`.
